{{Quote|From the slums of Arramanx to the forests of Kashyyyk, borcatu are everywhere. Zazu alone knows how they spread so fast. Zazu alone knows how we'll get rid of them &hellip;|Anonymous [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]|<ref name="CotG" />}}
'''Borcatu''' were small, bad-tempered scavengers originally found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Escabar]]. Their original habitat was the [[Desert/Legends|deserts]] of [[Serhan]], in the northeastern part of the planet. Beginning circa [[150 BBY/Legends|150 BBY]], when the ports of Escabar were opened to [[Galactic economy|interstellar trade]], the creatures began to spread from their homeworld by stowing away on departing [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], they could be found on planets from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Though originally desert animals, they easily adapted to habitats ranging from lush forests to [[City/Legends|urban]] slums.<ref name="CotG" />

Borcatu had a scaly, thick hide which may have evolved to help resist [[Sandstorm/Legends|sandstorms]]. They also have sharp [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] and claws, which they used to burrow or to defend themselves. They had a vicious temperament, biting anyone who came near them, and often fighting and cannibalizing one another when no other food source was available.<ref name="CotG" />

Eliminating a borcatu infestation was difficult. Their mottled, dark skin made effective camouflage, and their pups were only a few [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] long. As they were originally desert-adapted creatures, their metabolisms were also highly efficient, and they left very little waste. This made them difficult to find&mdash;and their natural weapons and quick movements made them tough to exterminate when they were found. [[Capital ship/Legends|Capital ships]] could host dozens of borcatu without the crew being aware of the infestation.<ref name="CotG" />
